title: WPSS/795/2019 of JYOTI RANA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No. 795 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, Advocate for
the petitoner.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Standing Counsel
for the Union of India.
Petitioner applied for the post of
Lecturer Physics in a Government Aided
College, namely, Sri Sanatan Dharm Inter
College, Rudrapur, pursuant to an
advertisement. Her name figured in the list
of top seven candidates who were to be
called for interview. According to the
petitioner, the Committee of Management
of the said College issued call letters to the
top seven candidates on 22.02.2019 calling
the short listed candidates for interview
which was to be held on 03.03.2019.
According to the petitioner, there was
deliberate delay in dispatching the call
letters, due to which petitioner, who resides
at Jaspur, received the call letter on
05.03.2019. Petitioner has alleged in the
writ petition that few other short listed
candidates also received the call letters
after the date of interview. This, according
to the petitioner, has been done
deliberately to ensure that someone close
to the Committee of Management may be
selected and appointed.
The allegation made in the writ
petition, if correct, is a matter of concern.
Teachers in Government Aided Institutions
are paid salary from public exchequer,
therefore, selection must be made purely
based on merit and other considerations
cannot be allowed to tinker with the
selection process. Public interest also

demands that most deserving candidate
should be appointed as teacher.
Having regard to the facts and
circumstances of this case, this court
thinks ends of justice would be met, if
petitioner is permitted to make a
representation before Regional Additional
Director of Education, Kumaun within two
weeks from today. The Additional Director
of Education shall look into the matter and
take appropriate decision, in accordance
with law, by passing a speaking order
within six weeksí thereafter.
It goes without saying that, before
taking any decision prejudicial to selected
candidates, the Additional Director shall
hear them.
Till such decision is taken,
appointment letter shall not be issued to
the selected candidates.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
 04.04.2019
NEHA
